usageNotes: Retrieves the full configuration of a single cluster-wide directory mapping by its config ID. The caller must hold at least one of Mapping.Use, Mapping.Modify, or Mapping.Audit on the specific mapping path — a token with only global admin may still fail if per-mapping ACLs are not set. Use this to inspect node-to-path overrides before attaching a directory mapping to a VM or container storage entry.

examples.summary: Fetch configuration for a directory mapping named 'local-backups'

tips: The id must match a pve-configid — alphanumeric plus hyphens/underscores, no spaces.
Returns an object whose 'map' array contains per-node path overrides; check this when diagnosing why a mapping resolves differently on different nodes.
Listing available IDs first via get_cluster_mapping_dir (the directory index) avoids 404s from typos.
